# Staley Electric

> > Family-owned electrical contractor serving Central Arkansas for over 65 years, specializing in residential electrical services, LED lighting upgrades, and home safety solutions.

Founded by R.E. Staley after World War II and now in its third generation under Brent Staley, Staley Electric provides comprehensive electrical services throughout Little Rock and Central Arkansas including England and Malvern.

## Key Topics

- Residential electrical services
- LED lighting upgrades
- Tamper-Resistant Receptacles (TRRs)
- Electrical safety and childproofing
- Circuit breakers and panel upgrades
- Central Arkansas service area
- Little Rock electrician
- Energy efficiency solutions
- Home electrical upgrades
- Family-owned business since WWII
- Third-generation electrical contractor
- Outlet safety and cord management
- HVAC electrical work
- Generator installation
